description: This file defines the singleton object 'ShopRepository' which provides mock data for categories and products, manages shopping cart state and recent searches, and handles local persistence of this data in an Android application.

classes.name: ShopRepository
classes.description: A singleton repository managing product data, cart state, recent searches, and local persistence.

classes.name: ShopRepository.CartItem
classes.description: A data class representing an item in the shopping cart, including the product and quantity.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Returns the list of product categories.

methods.name: getAllProducts
methods.description: Returns the list of all products.

methods.name: findProductById
methods.description: Finds and returns a product by its ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: getCategoryName
methods.description: Returns the name of a category given its ID.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the repository state from local storage, restoring cart and recent searches.

methods.name: cartLiveData
methods.description: Provides LiveData observing the current cart state.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds a specified quantity of a product to the cart.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity for a specific product in the cart.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.

methods.name: cartItems
methods.description: Returns a list of CartItem objects representing current cart contents.

methods.name: cartTotalCents
methods.description: Calculates the total price of the cart in cents.

methods.name: getRecentSearches
methods.description: Returns the list of recent search queries.

methods.name: recordSearchQuery
methods.description: Records and manages a recent search query, ensuring no duplicates and respecting maximum items.
